SURVEY OF INCOME AND PROGRAM PARTICIPATION,
CALENDAR YEAR 2025 REPLICATE WEIGHT FILE DATA DICTIONARY

  VARIABLE   TYPE	LENGTH

D SSUID      Char     	14
T SU: Sample Unit Identifier
     This identifier is created by scrambling together the PSU, 
     Segment, Serial, Serial Suffix, and Panel of the 
     original sample address.  It may be used 
     in matching sample units across years.
U All persons
V 00000000000000:99999999999999 .Scrambled Id


D PNUM        Num	3     
T PE: Person Number
     This field differentiates 
     persons within the sample unit. Person 
     number is unique within the sample unit.
V 101:499 .Person number


D SPANEL      Num	4     
T SU: Panel Year
U All persons
V 2021:2024 .Panel Year


D SWAVE       Num	1     
T SU: Wave of data collection
U All persons
V 1:4 .Wave of data collection


D MONTHCODE   Num	2     
T SU: Reference month of this record
U All persons
V 1:12 .Reference month


D REPWGT0     Num	14    
T WW: Final Person Weight
      This is equivalent to the variable WPFINWGT
      in the data file.
U All persons
V 0.000000:9999999.999999 .Final person weight


D REPWGT1     Num	14    
T WW: Final Person 1st Replicate Weight
U All persons
V 0.000000:9999999.999999 .Final person replicate weight 1
.
.
.
D REPWGT240   Num	14    
T WW: Final Person 240th Replicate Weight
U All persons
V 0.000000:9999999.999999 .Final person replicate weight 240
